narrative.details:
I have received word back from Darnassus, adventurer!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
narrative.objectives: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
narrative.offerRewardText: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it.At long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.Thank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.
narrative.requestItemsText: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
